body.name: paired numerical-delta construction
body.construction: \(\widehat F'_n(g)=\{F(\Pi_{\mathcal B}(\widehat\beta_n+t_ng))-F(\widehat\beta_n)\}/t_n\), where \(\Pi_{\mathcal B}\) is a locally feasible correction into the product of the two simplices and the response cube, is applied after projection to \(\mathbb T\), and is inactive with probability approaching one at every fixed interior \(\beta\). The same draw \(g=G_n^\star\) is used for both coordinates.
